summary: First-pass full-stack test of HorizonCare MVP. Backend pytest suite (24 tests) 100% passing: auth (all 3 roles + wrong pwd + register + role-guard), catalog chain (locations→specializations→hospitals→doctors + slots + next_available), booking (book/reschedule/cancel/queue + past/unavailable rejections), doctor flow (profile/stats/queue/status→prescription→PDF + availability), admin (analytics/roster CRUD/CSV/new-doctor-login), reviews (create + duplicate 400), AI Claude symptom-check (returns suggestions with specialization_id). set_status treats transition to 'in_progress' by auto-completing prior in_progress appointments for same doctor/date — good, but no state-machine guard against completed→confirmed regressions.
auth cookies are SameSite=None Secure httpOnly — correct for cross-origin.
No _id leakage: all endpoints project {'_id':0}. Good.
